admission.justification: Treating an older but open-capable plugin as unavailable would reload every selection and hide its actual limitation.

applicability: Ability negotiation and notices on the embedded native plugin channel.
conditions: Ready and pong describe plugin abilities; hello describes dashboard reply capabilities.
The provision command is settings-bound display text, not automatically executed.
exclusions: A missing new reply capability is not proof that supported ar.open is absent.

evidence: dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoFrameLateAnswer.test.tsx › "is named with the provisioning command and still switches by message when it …" (three rows), "is named when it cannot show a chat on request, and each chat is then loaded by its address"; mcp/tests/test_paseo_frame.py (provisionCommand)

statement: The dashboard and the plug-in tell each other what they can do; a plug-in that lacks something this dashboard uses is named as older in the frame's notice with the command that provisions the current one, and every plug-in that can show an agent on request still switches by message.
